cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(widgetuse LANGUAGES C)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
add_library(widgetuse STATIC use.c)
set(_widget_dirs "")
if(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX)
	if(CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR)
		list(APPEND _widget_dirs "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}")
	endif()
	list(APPEND _widget_dirs
		"${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib"
		"${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib64")
endif()
set(_widget_lib "")
foreach(_dir IN LISTS _widget_dirs)
	foreach(_name IN ITEMS
			widget.lib libwidget.lib libwidget.so libwidget.dylib)
		if(EXISTS "${_dir}/${_name}")
			set(_widget_lib "${_dir}/${_name}")
			break()
		endif()
	endforeach()
	if(_widget_lib)
		break()
	endif()
endforeach()
if(_widget_lib STREQUAL "")
	message(FATAL_ERROR "widget library not found in: ${_widget_dirs}")
endif()
target_link_libraries(widgetuse PUBLIC "${_widget_lib}")
install(TARGETS widgetuse ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR})
